```{=html}
  <p class="small muted" style="margin-top:18px">Adding a paper? See <a href="https://github.com/sustainability-lab/sustainability-lab.github.io/blob/main/papers/README.md">papers/README.md</a> — one entry in <code>data/publications.yml</code>.</p>
</section>
<script>
(function () {
  let theme = 'all';
  const q = document.getElementById('pubsearch');
  function apply() {
    const term = q.value.toLowerCase().trim(); let n = 0;
    const pubs = document.querySelectorAll('#publist .pub');
    pubs.forEach(p => {
      const ok = (theme === 'all' || p.dataset.t.split(' ').includes(theme)) && (!term || p.textContent.toLowerCase().includes(term));
      p.style.display = ok ? '' : 'none'; if (ok) n++;
    });
    document.querySelectorAll('#publist .year').forEach(y => {
      let el = y.nextElementSibling, any = false;
      while (el && !el.classList.contains('year')) { if (el.style.display !== 'none') any = true; el = el.nextElementSibling; }
      y.style.display = any ? '' : 'none';
    });
    document.getElementById('pubcount').textContent = n + ' of ' + pubs.length + ' papers';
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('#pubchips .chip').forEach(c => c.onclick = () => {
    document.querySelectorAll('#pubchips .chip').forEach(x => x.classList.toggle('on', x === c));
    theme = c.dataset.t; apply();
  });
  q.oninput = apply;
  apply();
})();
</script>
```

:::
